Title: Update your Azure Cosmos DB Python SDK by 31 August 2022

Body.Content:
We are extending the retirement announcement of 1.x and 2.x of the Azure Cosmos DB Python SDK for SQL API from 31 August 2020 to 31 August 2022.

How does this affect me?

After 31 August 2022, Azure Cosmos DB will no longer make bug fixes, add new features, and provide support to versions 1.x or 2.x of the Azure Cosmos DB Python SDK for SQL API. If you prefer not to upgrade, requests sent from version 1.x and 2.x of the SDK will continue to be served by the Azure Cosmos DB service.

What actions should I take?

Update your application to use version 4.x of the Python SDK for Azure Cosmos DB. If you have a support plan and need technical support, please contact us.
